newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products undermined by U.S. gasoline dump.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products undermined by U.S. gasoline dump.

text.p: NWE oil products whipsawed between a U.S. gasoline futures sell-off and a tight supply picture on Thursday, traders said.

Gasoline came under heavy pressure from the pre-expiry dump of the August NYMEX contract. But while prices shed early gains the slide was halted by tight supplies and finished the day with few losses.

Gas oil eased $1.75 a tonne in line with August IPE last trading at $169.25. Spreads were mixed. Diesel cargoes firmed to Aug IPE +$4/5.25. Prompt heating oil barges traded at premiums of between 50 cents and $1 over August IPE.
NWE high sulphur barges traded higher at $93, $93.25 and $93.50 on supply worries, and low sulphur cargo numbers jumped $1 to $94/$95 to maintain a differential.
